constraints: Keep default ingestion local, bounded and cancellable; do not transmit prompts, transcripts, credentials, code or diffs to providers.
Keep provider parsing behind normalized adapters and core storage separate from AppKit state; helper ingestion must not require the UI.
Require exact selected paths, symlink resolution, matching precondition hashes, atomic writes, audit and guarded undo for Playbook changes.
Keep optional provider-assisted analysis outside the monitor and preserve separate review before any future disclosure.
Treat startup/helper installation as explicit user actions, never test defaults.
Keep unknown usage/quota and inferred status explicit; do not claim live provider state from local records.
Core tests do not certify native workbench actions, installed helper lifecycle or release capture/accessibility evidence.

Do not infer multi-file undo atomicity from the single-file undo tests: restoreApplied currently writes previousContent on partial undo failure, so recovery of already undone entries remains a concrete implementation gap.
bindings.handoff_review: RelayCore owns adapters/store/inference/usage/playbook and guarded file transactions; RelayApp owns AppKit interaction; RelayHelper shares monitoring without the UI. These documented target seams remain one coherent local-workbench root. Explicit file selection/confirmation precedes guarded apply; provider-assisted analysis is outside default monitoring. Native actions may launch configured tmux/Terminal only from selected user actions.

decisions.summary: Bounded local session ingestion and guarded playbook file transactions; exact path-to-outcome association requires owner reconciliation.
Associate existing local workbench outcomes and documented core/native/helper boundaries without changing execution, installation or release authority.
